title: Negative Inversion
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! La inversión negativa es la estructura más dramática y enfática del idioma inglés. Al dominarla, tus discursos y escritos tendrán la autoridad de un líder de talla mundial.

parts.visual:
En inglés, cuando comenzamos una oración con una palabra o frase negativa (Never, Rarely, Under no circumstances), debemos INVERTIR el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar, como si fuera una pregunta. 

1. Never / Rarely / Seldom (Nunca / Rara vez): 
Normal: I have never seen such a disaster. 
Inversion: NEVER HAVE I seen such a disaster. 
Normal: The CEO rarely admits a mistake. 
Inversion: RARELY DOES the CEO admit a mistake. 

2. Not only... but also (No solo... sino también): 
Normal: He not only lied, but he also stole money. 
Inversion: NOT ONLY DID HE lie, but he also stole money.
parts.audio: Welcome to Negative Inversion. This is one of the most advanced and dramatic grammar structures in English. When we start a sentence with a negative word or phrase, we must INVERT the subject and the auxiliary verb, exactly as if we were asking a question. Let's look at Number 1: Words like Never, Rarely, or Seldom. Normal sentence: I have never seen such a disaster. Inversion for emphasis: NEVER HAVE I seen such a disaster. Normal: The CEO rarely admits a mistake. Inversion: RARELY DOES the CEO admit a mistake. Number 2: Not only... but also. Normal: He not only lied, but he also stole money. Inversion: NOT ONLY DID HE lie, but he also stole money.

parts.visual:
3. Under no circumstances (Bajo ninguna circunstancia): 
Normal: You should not sign this contract under any circumstances. 
Inversion: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU sign this contract. 

4. On no account (Por ningún motivo): 
Normal: Employees must not talk to the press on any account. 
Inversion: ON NO ACCOUNT MUST employees talk to the press. 

5. Hardly / Scarcely... when (Apenas... cuando): 
- Se usa para indicar que una acción ocurrió inmediatamente después de otra. 
Normal: I had hardly sat down when the phone rang. 
Inversion: HARDLY HAD I sat down WHEN the phone rang.
parts.audio: Number 3: Under no circumstances. Normal: You should not sign this contract under any circumstances. Inversion: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU sign this contract. Number 4: On no account, which means for no reason. Normal: Employees must not talk to the press on any account. Inversion: ON NO ACCOUNT MUST employees talk to the press. Finally, Number 5: Hardly or Scarcely... when. This is used to say that one thing happened immediately after another. Normal: I had hardly sat down when the phone rang. Inversion: HARDLY HAD I sat down WHEN the phone rang.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la oración con la inversión correcta.

questions.question: Normal: I have never seen such incompetence. -> Inversion: Never ____ such incompetence.
questions.explanation: Inversión del Present Perfect: Never have I seen.

questions.question: Normal: The manager rarely leaves before 8 PM. -> Inversion: Rarely ____ before 8 PM.
questions.explanation: Inversión del Present Simple: Rarely does the manager leave.

questions.question: Normal: She not only broke the rules, but she also lied. -> Inversion: Not only ____ the rules, but she also lied.
questions.explanation: Inversión del Past Simple: Not only did she break.

questions.question: Normal: You should not share this password under any circumstances. -> Inversion: Under no circumstances ____ this password.
questions.explanation: Inversión con modal: Under no circumstances should you share.

questions.question: Normal: We had hardly signed the deal when the market crashed. -> Inversion: Hardly ____ the deal when the market crashed.
questions.explanation: Inversión de Past Perfect: Hardly had we signed.

questions.question: Normal: He little realized that his microphone was on. -> Inversion: Little ____ that his microphone was on.
questions.explanation: Inversión con 'Little' (Poco sabía/se daba cuenta): Little did he realize.

questions.question: Normal: You must not open this door on any account. -> Inversion: On no account ____ this door.
questions.explanation: Inversión: On no account must you open.

questions.question: Normal: I will never invest in that company again. -> Inversion: Never again ____ in that company.
questions.explanation: Inversión de futuro: Never again will I invest.

questions.question: Normal: The board seldom agrees so quickly. -> Inversion: Seldom ____ so quickly.
Normal: He not only missed the deadline, but he also lost the file. -> Inversion: ____ did he miss the deadline, but he also lost the file.
questions.explanation: Not only did he... but also...

questions.question: Normal: I had no sooner left the building than the fire alarm rang. -> Inversion: No sooner ____ the building than the fire alarm rang.
questions.explanation: No sooner + had I left + than.

questions.question: Normal: We will only sign if you lower the price. -> Inversion: Only if you lower the price ____.
questions.explanation: Only if... + inversión: Only if you lower the price will we sign.

questions.question: Normal: The security guards noticed nothing until the alarm went off. -> Inversion: Not until the alarm went off ____ anything.
Normal: She had scarcely finished her speech when the applause erupted. -> Inversion: Scarcely ____ her speech when the applause erupted.
Normal: I have never felt so insulted. -> Inversion: Never ____ so insulted.
Inversion con adjetivos: ____ was the storm that all flights were cancelled. (Tan grande fue la tormenta).
questions.explanation: Such was the storm... (Tan grande fue la tormenta...).

questions.question: Inversion con 'So': So devastating ____ that the company went bankrupt. (Tan devastador fue el error).
Normal: The CEO had never faced such a crisis. -> Inversion: Never ____ such a crisis.
____ circumstances should you contact the press. (Bajo ninguna).
¿Qué oración es INCORRECTA en inglés C2?
options: Not only did he lie, but...
questions.explanation: Incorrecta porque NO invierte el sujeto y el auxiliar (debería ser 'Never have I seen').

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el auxiliar correcto para la inversión.

questions.question: Never ____ I seen such a mess. (He visto)
Rarely ____ he arrive on time. (Él llega)
Not only ____ they lie, but they also stole. (Mintieron en pasado)
Under no circumstances ____ you sign this. (Deberías)
Hardly ____ I sat down when the phone rang. (Había)
Never again ____ I trust them. (Futuro con W)
On no account ____ employees speak to media. (Deber afirmativo firme con M)
Little ____ he know the truth. (Él sabía en pasado)
No sooner ____ we arrived than it rained. (Habíamos)
Only if we win ____ we celebrate. (Futuro con W)
